summary.text: Purple Star Broken Life is Fang Yuan's immortal battlefield killer move. He named it to conceal traces and isolate the trapped space from the outside world.

claims.text: You Chan and Qin Bai He are trapped inside. The immortal battlefield is completely flawless, like a dark red egg around the three immortals, with countless purple stars shining in the egg shell. Fang Yuan created it by deduction using three rank eight battlefield killer moves and eighteen killer moves as reference. The space inside is huge, but it occupies only one tiny spot in the outside world, so even if anyone came, they would not notice the battlefield.

He wills countless purple stars to descend and fill the world. After creating a wisdom path environment he has a huge territorial advantage and suppresses both water path and wood path. The battlefield contains many of Fang Yuan’s wisdom path Immortal Gu. Other paths still face suppression and conflict. He deduced a wisdom path battlefield killer move first because that path’s advantage is concealment and preventing deductions.

Qing Yue Zhi Cheng finds no traces of battle at white crane sea area, and would find none at dragonfish sea area either. The fight was conducted in this battlefield killer move, and Fang Yuan’s methods to erase traces are outstanding.

Fang Yuan had deduced this immortal battlefield killer move and set it up using the wisdom path Immortal Gu that Purple Mountain True Monarch left behind. He used it to kill You Chan and Qin Bai He. Its advantage is concealing itself and isolating from the outside world. Its weakness is that it needs time to set up, so prior preparation is often required. If one tried to use it in battle, Gu Immortals would run away before it was set up. Yama battlefield is inferior to it in concealment and isolating from the outside world, but needs only three blinks of time to activate.
Among Fang Yuan’s immortal battlefields, the strongest are this move and yama battlefield. Both are rank seven and cannot trap rank eight Gu Immortals such as Xia Cha and Lu Wei Yin.
